rationale: The assistant correctly identified the likely cause: humidity (55%) is already below the 60% target and the garage is cold. It did not say dehumidifiers are outside the service, so it treated the case as in-scope with a full diagnosis, though it gave no unsupported fault claim and pointed to Meaco support only conditionally. It did suggest a desiccant model (Meaco DD8L) as a possible replacement, which is a mild product suggestion. Some details, such as the claim that the fan keeps running on this model, are stated with more confidence than is supported.
outcome_note: Only partially matches the expected out-of-scope handling.
